using ll = long long;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<ll> a(n);
    for (ll i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    priority_queue<ll> heap;
    const ll keep = n / 2 + 1;

    for (ll x : a) {
        heap.push(x);
        if ((long long)heap.size() > keep) {
            heap.pop();
        }
    }

    cout << heap.top() << '\n';
    return 0;
